title: Разбор возвратов
purpose: Senior rank: how comebacks are counted and reviewed each month, and where the review is not happening.
differs_from_en: A comeback is a warranty or goodwill order opened within 30 days of the order it repeats (ledger comeback.definition); the page adds a quarterly look at paid repeat orders on the same unit, because the warranty window is short.
Same ladder (3 % and 4 %) and the same company target (ledger comeback.company.ru 2.55 %).
Kazan has the highest rate (ledger comeback.west.ru 3.32 %; slot 27 at 5.31 %).
new_facts: A quarterly look at paid repeat orders on the same unit after day 30 (no data footprint).
